name: Notifications, Alerts & Confirmations
when_to_use: A stat or achievement appears, 'it worked' moments, task or render complete, a new DM / email / sale notification on screen, checklist completion, an error beat, a soft ding on a highlighted caption keyword.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 01
sounds.desc: Soft, low pure-tone digital beep that fades in over 150 ms; a subtle notification or HUD prompt under voice.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 02
sounds.desc: Smooth tonal swell that rises over 0.3 s into a held tone; a gentle 'incoming' notification or HUD prompt.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 03
sounds.desc: Digital alert tone of about 0.4 s with a steady body; use for an on-screen alert or a system message appearing.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 01
sounds.desc: Digital denied tone that hits and decays over about a quarter second; use when an action is rejected or a 'wrong way' beat lands.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 02
sounds.desc: Digital denied tone with a clean half-second decay tail; use when a request is rejected and the moment needs to breathe.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 03
sounds.desc: Mid-low digital denied blip with a clean fade under 200 ms; a neat 'no' for a failed check or crossed-out item.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 01
sounds.desc: A mid-pitched digital buzzer that hits instantly and eases off over a third of a second, for a wrong-answer or access-denied beat.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 02
sounds.desc: A very tonal, clean 0.27 s digital buzz, for a crisp error or access-denied beat in an app demo.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 03
sounds.desc: A tonal digital buzz with some low-end body, 0.35 s long, for a firmer error or 'that didn't work' beat.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 01
sounds.desc: Punchy bright digital notification blip with a quick fade at 250 ms; good for a new message or alert landing on screen.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 02
sounds.desc: Short digital notification ping that hits immediately and fades in 170 ms; fits a stat or alert card appearing.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 03
sounds.desc: Clean 200 ms digital blip with a quick fade; use for a notification badge or a keyword appearing.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 04
sounds.desc: Bright tonal blip that rises to a loud peak then drops away, about 225 ms; a punchy notification for a new message or stat.

sounds.name: Digital Warning Tone 01
sounds.desc: Digital warning tone with some low weight that hits and decays cleanly over half a second; fits an alert or danger beat.

sounds.name: Digital Warning Tone 02
sounds.desc: Steady tonal warning beep of about 350 ms with hard edges; use for a caution popup or a danger alert on screen.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 01
sounds.desc: A fuller 1 s digital error alert with low-end weight that decays away; use for a 'system failed' moment or a big error beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 01
sounds.desc: A 620 ms mid-range digital alert that rises into its peak; use for a caution or warning popup.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 02
sounds.desc: A 590 ms digital warning with a clean fade in and out; use for a warning banner sliding on.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 03
sounds.desc: A 660 ms digital alert that builds then falls away; use for an alert or 'danger' callout.

sounds.name: Low Denied Blip 01
sounds.desc: Short, dark low-pitched tonal blip of 100 ms like a muted 'nope' button; good for a cancel tap or a subtle wrong-answer beat.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 01
sounds.desc: A brighter, wide-stereo sci-fi confirm chime with a soft 75 ms bloom and a 0.7 s tail; use for task-complete or render-done moments in AI demos.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 02
sounds.desc: A bright-edged tonal confirm with a soft attack, wide stereo and about 0.6 s of decay; use on a success state or an approval in an app mockup.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Confirm Chime 01
sounds.desc: Fuller, louder confirm-all tone with a longer bright tail; use when a whole task or render completes.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Confirm Chime 02
sounds.desc: A crisp 0.3 s synth confirm chime; use for an 'it worked' moment, a render finishing or a checklist completing.

sounds.subtype: soft glass ding for keyword emphasis
sounds.name: Glass Ding 01
sounds.desc: A high pure crystalline ping with a long ring; use for a glint on a keyword or a soft highlight on a stat.

sounds.name: Modern Notification Ding 01
sounds.desc: A bright tonal ding with a ringing decay of about 0.65 s; use for a message or task-complete notification appearing on screen.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Complete Chime 01
sounds.desc: A tonal confirm chime with a fast attack and a long 1.3 s ringing tail; use for task-complete or render-finished moments, trimming the tail under voice.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 03
sounds.desc: A mid-bright tonal confirm chime of about 0.6 s with a quick onset; use for a success beat or a prompt being accepted.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 04
sounds.desc: A bass-weighted but airy tonal confirm with a slightly wide stereo image, about 0.6 s long; fits a confirm tap or a stat landing in a UI card.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.subtype: soft glass ding for keyword emphasis
sounds.name: Soft Ting 01
sounds.desc: Tonal ringing 'tingg' with a ~0.6 s tail; use for a soft ding when a keyword or stat lands.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Bright Alarm Buzzer 01
sounds.desc: A bright half-second alarm buzz that hits at once and fades, for a warning callout or a red-flag moment.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 04
sounds.desc: Quiet, slow-building digital tone of about 0.6 s; a soft background notification or HUD prompt under narration.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 05
sounds.desc: Steady tonal digital alert of about 0.4 s with a hard stop; use for a system notice or a warning badge.

sounds.name: Digital Alert Tone 06
sounds.desc: Tonal digital alert lasting just over half a second with a held body; use for a system message or warning popup.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 04
sounds.desc: Mid-range digital cancel tone with some body and a quick fade at 300 ms; fits a declined request or a crossed-out step.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 05
sounds.desc: Buzzer-like tonal denied tone with rich harmonics and a quick fade, about 200 ms; classic 'wrong' feedback for a failed action.

sounds.name: Digital Denied Tone 06
sounds.desc: Mid-range digital tone that swells in and fades out over about 200 ms; a softer denied or cancel cue for app demos.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 04
sounds.desc: A slightly brighter, louder digital error buzz of about 0.35 s, for flagging a mistake or a rejected action on screen.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 05
sounds.desc: A quieter mid-pitched digital buzz of 0.36 s, for a subtle error or rejected-input moment.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 06
sounds.desc: A mid-pitched digital buzz that hits at once and tapers over 0.34 s, for an incorrect or denied beat.

sounds.name: Digital Error Buzzer 07
sounds.desc: A loud 0.4 s mid-pitched digital buzzer held at full level, for an emphatic error or denied-access moment.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 05
sounds.desc: Loud, short 130 ms digital notification blip with a hard stop; use for a badge popping up or a quick on-screen alert.

sounds.name: Digital Notify Blip 06
sounds.desc: Slightly gritty digital ping that decays to silence in a quarter second; works for a pop-up alert or a list item landing.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 02
sounds.desc: A 240 ms mid-range digital warning blast with a fast onset; use for a quick error or denied beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 03
sounds.desc: A 430 ms mid-range digital alert that falls away; use for a denied or wrong-answer beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 04
sounds.desc: A tonal 390 ms digital alert that swells and fades out cleanly; use for a soft warning or caution beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 05
sounds.desc: A 495 ms digital alert hit that decays quickly; use when an error message appears on screen.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 06
sounds.desc: A gritty 790 ms digital error alert with an instant onset; use for an error screen or failure beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 04
sounds.desc: A 500 ms digital warning that swells up then stops; use when a warning icon appears.

sounds.name: Low Denied Blip 02
sounds.desc: Low tonal cancel blip around 200 ms with a clean fade; a soft, unobtrusive 'no' for a cancel button or failed check.

sounds.name: Low Denied Blip 03
sounds.desc: Tiny 70 ms low-mid tonal blip; works as a cancel or back-button tap in a screen recording.

sounds.name: Low Error Buzzer 01
sounds.desc: A low-mid tonal digital buzz of 0.34 s that peaks near its end, for a denied or incorrect beat.

sounds.name: Low Error Buzzer 02
sounds.desc: A soft, low, very tonal 0.3 s buzz, for a gentle 'nope' or wrong-way beat under a caption.

sounds.name: Low Error Buzzer 03
sounds.desc: A deep, low mono buzzer like a wrong-answer horn, for a failed attempt or a tongue-in-cheek 'wrong' beat.

sounds.name: Bright Alarm Buzzer 02
sounds.desc: A piercing, very high tonal whine-buzz of 0.3 s, for a sharp warning flag or an alarm going off on screen.

sounds.name: Bright Alarm Buzzer 03
sounds.desc: A short, very bright 0.28 s alarm buzz, for a quick warning flash or an error badge popping up.

sounds.name: Cancel Tone 01
sounds.desc: Pure mid-pitched cancel beep that decays over about 0.7 s; use for a denied action, a wrong answer or closing a dialog.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Cancel Tone 02
sounds.desc: Brighter, slightly noisy cancel tone with a long decaying tail; use when backing out of a menu or a step is rejected.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Cancel Tone 03
sounds.desc: Airy, bright cancel-all tone, softer in level; use when clearing a list or dismissing several panels at once.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Confirm Chime 03
sounds.desc: Bright, clicky confirm tone with a short ringing tail; use when a button press succeeds or a step is approved in an app demo.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Confirm Chime 04
sounds.desc: Shorter, brighter confirm tone that decays in about 0.4 s; use for quick approvals or a checklist item completing.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Confirm Chime 05
sounds.desc: A bright synth confirmation chime with a half-second decay; use when a task completes or a result lands as a success.

sounds.name: Digital Warning Buzz 01
sounds.desc: A bright, steady 290 ms digital warning buzz with hard edges; use for a quick error or 'wrong way' beat.

sounds.name: Digital Warning Buzz 02
sounds.desc: A 450 ms bright, fairly tonal digital warning buzz; use for an error popup or warning appearing on screen.

sounds.name: Error Beep 01
sounds.desc: A short bright synth error blip; use on a denied click, wrong answer or 'that's the wrong way' beat.

sounds.name: Error Beep 02
sounds.desc: A buzzy bright error blip; use for a rejected action, failed login or wrong-way moment.

sounds.name: Error Beep 03
sounds.desc: A synth error tone with a half-second decay; use when something fails on screen or a claim is shown to be wrong.

sounds.name: Error Beep 04
sounds.desc: A quick 0.1 s mid error blip; use on a denied button press or invalid input in an app demo.

sounds.name: Error Buzz Low 01
sounds.desc: A low subby error thud; use for a heavier failure beat like a rejected action or a broken workflow.

sounds.name: Error Buzz Low 02
sounds.desc: A low dull error tone with a soft onset; use for a 'nope' or failed-attempt moment.

sounds.name: Error Buzz Low 03
sounds.desc: A punchy low error thump; use on a wrong answer, denied click or crossed-out old method.

sounds.name: Error Buzz Low 04
sounds.desc: A short low error buzz; use for a quick denied or invalid beat in a screen recording.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Alert 07
sounds.desc: A bright, noisy 400 ms error hit with an instant attack; use for an error popup or failed action.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 05
sounds.desc: A short, bright 255 ms warning chirp that builds; use for a quick alert badge or warning flash.

sounds.name: Glitch Warning Swell 06
sounds.desc: A 710 ms digital alarm that swells from silence and cuts off at full level; use leading straight into an error screen.

sounds.name: High Warning Whine 01
sounds.desc: Very bright, high-pitched sustained warning whine of just over half a second; use for an alarm state or a critical error screen.

sounds.name: Low Sci-Fi Confirm 01
sounds.desc: A short, deep tonal confirm with some sub weight, about 0.4 s long; use as a solid low accepted cue under a button press or a keyword emphasis.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Low Sci-Fi Confirm 02
sounds.desc: A very bass-heavy, rounded tonal confirm of about 0.55 s, nearly mono; fits a weighty confirm or a stat card settling into place.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Low Sci-Fi Confirm 03
sounds.desc: A low-mid tonal confirm that starts firmly and decays in under 0.5 s; use for a firm approve or submit beat in a UI demo.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 05
sounds.desc: A warm, mid-low tonal sci-fi confirm chime with a quick attack and about 0.7 s of decay; use when an action succeeds or a button is approved in an app demo.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 06
sounds.desc: A softer, quieter tonal confirm with a warm low-mid body and about 0.7 s of decay; good for a subtle done on a checklist tick or an approved task.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Chime 07
sounds.desc: A short, rounded tonal confirm with a soft 85 ms swell-in, about 0.4 s long; good for a select-and-confirm tap or a list item being approved.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Confirm Swell 01
sounds.desc: A tonal confirm that swells in over about 0.2 s and fades out by 0.75 s; use for a softer reveal of a success state or a panel confirming.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Soft Bloop Echo 01
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop followed by an echoing tail of about 1.1 s; use as a calm notification or an item landing when there is room for the tail.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Bloop Echo 02
sounds.desc: A slightly lower soft bloop with an echoing 1.1 s tail; use for a gentle notification or a key point landing.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Bloop Echo 03
sounds.desc: The highest of the soft echo bloops, with a tail of about 1.2 s; use for a calm notification when the voice leaves a gap.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Low Chime 01
sounds.desc: A soft, low, rounded tone with a gentle 0.65 s decay; use as a calm notification or to mark a key point without startling the viewer.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Low Chime 02
sounds.desc: A soft, low rounded tone a touch higher than 01, with a 0.65 s decay; use for a calm notification or key-point marker.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Low Chime 03
sounds.desc: The loudest and longest of the soft low tones, ringing for about 0.85 s; use for a calm task-complete or notification moment.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.subtype: soft glass ding for keyword emphasis
sounds.name: Soft Ting 02
sounds.desc: Tiny, quiet bright 'ting' under 0.2 s; use as a subtle ding on a highlighted caption keyword.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Two-Note Chime 01
sounds.desc: A soft, low tone whose second note peaks around 0.1 s, then decays gently for about a second; use for a quiet success or task-complete moment.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Two-Note Chime 02
sounds.desc: A soft, low tone that swells into its main note at about 0.18 s and rings for about a second; use for a gentle confirm or render-complete beat.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: UI Ping 01
sounds.desc: Quiet bright ping that starts instantly and rings for about 0.5 s; use for a small notification or a stat appearing.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited
